{"sql": "
WITH windows AS (
  SELECT 'accounting_2026' AS w, '2026-04-05' AS s, '2026-06-27' AS e
  UNION ALL SELECT 'accounting_2025', '2025-04-06', '2025-06-28'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'operations_2026', '2026-04-04', '2026-06-26'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'operations_2025', '2025-04-05', '2025-06-27'
)
SELECT w.w AS window, SUM(p.qty*p.unit_price) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM windows w
JOIN pos_sales p ON p.sold_on BETWEEN w.s AND w.e
WHERE p.store IN ('S1','S2','S3')
GROUP BY w.w
ORDER BY w.w
"}

WITH windows AS (
  SELECT 'accounting_2026' AS w, '2026-04-05' AS s, '2026-06-27' AS e
  UNION ALL SELECT 'accounting_2025', '2025-04-06', '2025-06-28'

  UNION ALL SELECT 'operations_2025', '2025-04-05', '2025-06-27'
)
SELECT w.w AS window, p.store, SUM(p.qty*p.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM windows w
JOIN pos_sales p ON p.sold_on BETWEEN w.s AND w.e
WHERE p.store IN ('S1','S2','S3')
GROUP BY w.w, p.store
ORDER BY p.store, w.w
"}
